editorial.blurb: Sfera is a tiny, beloved Sicilian spot turning out impressively authentic arancini and sandwiches that punch well above their weight, earning passionate devotion from those who discover it.
editorial.insiderTip: The arancini are the signature move—order the classico or porcini and wild garlic varieties and pair with the marinara sauce; eat in person at one of their 7 seats for the full experience, or snag outdoor seating in warmer months.
signatureDishes: Roasted Chicken Red Pepper Pesto Sandwich
